First, note the given date: 11-11-1471 (November 11, 1471).  
Subtract 338 days:  

1471 is not a leap year (leap years divisible by 4 but before 1582, though 1472 is leap).  
From Nov 11, 1471, go back 11 days → Oct 31, 1471.  
Remaining: 338 − 11 = 327 days earlier.  

Go back through October (31 days), September (30), August (31), July (31), June (30), May (31), April (30), March (31), February (28 in 1471), January (31).  

Sum: 31+30+31+31+30+31+30+31+28+31 = 304 days (back to Jan 1, 1471).  
Remaining: 327 − 304 = 23 days before Jan 1, 1471.  

23 days before Jan 1, 1471 = Dec 9, 1470 (since Dec has 31 days: Jan 1 → Dec 31 is 1 day back, so 23 days back = Dec 31 − 22 days = Dec 9).  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1470-12-09
